{{Quote|Talon Twelve, dive for the surface. Trench Run Defense. Omega Signal. Acknowledge.''"<br />"''Omega Signal understood. Diving."|Myn Donos and "Talon Twelve" after being ambushed|<ref name="WS" />}}
"'''Talon Twelve'''" was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who flew an [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic Starfighter Command/Legends|Starfighter Command]] as part of [[Talon Squadron (New Republic)|Talon Squadron]].<ref name="WS" />

During a simple mission to follow a lone [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptor]] in a New Republic-controlled system, Talon Squadron was [[Ambush at Gravan Seven|ambushed]] by numerically superior forces belonging to [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]. "Talon Twelve" and [[Brevet]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Myn Donos]] were the only survivors of the initial volley of lasers. She was pursued by a dozen [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] and suffered minor damages. The TIE Interceptor they were pursuing, which Donos learned was part of the [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Group]], suddenly returned just as they were about to retreat. Her starfighter's engines were badly damaged by the Interceptor's laser strikes and was ordered to eject by Donos. The canopy of her fighter refused to give way and she found herself slammed into it by her ejection seat. When the canopy finally gave way, she was unconscious and soon [[Death/Legends|killed]] when she was ejected into a rift wall.<ref name="WS" />
